definitions.explanation: NHK's long-running television drama series, broadcast in 15-minute episodes every weekday morning; each story runs for about six months, usually following one woman's life.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}ドラ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧。
⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{朝|あさ}ドラ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My mother looks forward to the morning drama every day.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}ドラ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ヒロイン→ヒロイン：11278_hiroin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦きっかけ→きっかけ：10309_kikkake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧になった。
examples.english: Being chosen as the heroine of the morning drama made her famous overnight.

notes:
Short for NHK's ⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧ ("serial television novel"), on air since 1961. Most series follow a young woman's life over many years, and the lead role often launches an actress's career.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {朝|あさ}ドラ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ヒロイン→ヒロイン：11278_hiroin⟧: the heroine (lead actress) of the morning drama
- {朝|あさ}ドラ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{主題歌|しゅだいか}→主題歌：11467_shudaika⟧: the morning drama's theme song
- {朝|あさ}ドラ⟦{女優|じょゆう}→女優：03353_joyuu⟧: an actress who has starred in a morning drama
